qa_pair.question: One software component is both reported as a finding in more than one product and listed in the SBOM that was imported for the Payments API product. Give that component as name:version.
Exactly one observation of the Payments API product has been assessed to the status "Not affected". Which VEX justification was recorded with that assessment?
How many license components of the Payments API product does its license policy evaluate as Forbidden?
Which scanner has reported at least one finding in every one of the three products?
How many observations belonging to products in the "Platform" product group still have the status Open?
The Legacy Batch product has exactly one observation with Critical severity. What is its title?
On the release/2.0 branch of the Payments API product, what is the title of the finding with the highest severity?
Which file was uploaded to create the observations on the release/2.0 branch of the Payments API product?
How many products in this instance currently do not pass their security gate?
One observation in this instance has been given the status "Risk accepted". On which date does that risk acceptance expire? Answer as YYYY-MM-DD.
Without calling the SecObserve API at all, name the resource that holds the assessment history of observations, including the approval state of each assessment.
The resource catalogue deliberately does not list the filters a resource accepts. Which endpoint of the running instance does this server read to answer "what can I filter observations by"?
Try to list observations filtered by vulnerability_id. What do you get back, and what does that tell you about filter names in general?
qa_pair.answer: An error, raised before any request is sent: vulnerability_id is not a filter of 'observations', and the message lists the filters that are accepted. It never returns an unfiltered list, because django-filter would have ignored the parameter silently and the count would have been wrong.

qa_pair.question: What happens if you call the list tool with an argument named filter instead of filters?
qa_pair.answer: The call is rejected as an unknown argument. Unknown arguments are forbidden, so a misspelled argument name can never be dropped in silence and return an unfiltered list.

qa_pair.question: How many observations in this instance carry the vulnerability id CVE-2021-44228, and how many different products are they spread over?
Page through every observation in this instance with page_size=5. How many observations are there in total, and how many pages does that take?
Listing observations returns a reduced set of fields per row. How many fields is the default projection, and what do you pass to get every column the API returns instead?
Both observations and license_components can be projected down to the name of their product, but the field is not spelled the same way. Give the field name for each.
qa_pair.answer: product_data.name for observations, product_name for license_components

qa_pair.question: A free-text search of observations for "credential" matches how many findings, and in which products?
qa_pair.answer: 2 findings: one in Payments API, one in Legacy Batch

qa_pair.question: Product metrics are pre-aggregated and count only a product's default branch. How many open Critical observations does the current metrics snapshot report for the Payments API product?

Counting every branch, which product has the most observations still in status Open, and how many does it have?
One scanner in this instance reported a finding that has since been assessed as a False positive. Which scanner is it, and which products has it reported findings in?
qa_pair.answer: SARIF, in Legacy Batch and Web Frontend
